headline: Expiry‑day trading is costing you a lot.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The cost of this behaviour is ₹1,16,891. Your expiry‑day slice comprised 90 trades and resulted in a loss of ₹1,16,891. In contrast, the remaining 124 trades lost ₹449 on average, had a win rate of 37% and a 5% loss, while the expiry‑day slice had a win rate of 29%, an average loss of ₹1,299 and a 28% loss.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: You might want to adopt the suggested rule for expiry‑day trades in the next review period.
